Created the complete four-page CampusFlow app in `/work`: `index.html`, `catalog.html`, `registration.html`, and `profile.html`, with shared CSS and JavaScript modules.

Includes responsive colorful design, 18 sample courses, live search and filters, registration form validation, confirmation modal, localStorage persistence, registered-course tables, editable student profile, mobile navigation, and accessibility features such as skip links, focus management, ARIA states, and accessible form errors.

Open `index.html` to start. No build step required. HTML/JS validated and all flows exercised with no console errors.
